title: NAF
paper_title: Neural Attenuation Fields for Sparse-View CBCT Reconstruction
core_mech: 以 hash-encoded 坐标网络表示 X-ray attenuation，并用 Beer–Lambert 重投影误差逐病例优化。
core_mech_en: Rewrites NeRF for cone-beam CT by replacing view-dependent emission–absorption with an isotropic X-ray linear attenuation field μ(x) optimized via Beer–Lambert reprojection error and hash encoding.
input_desc: 稀疏视角 CBCT 投影 y、每幅投影的射线几何
input_en: 3D spatial coordinates x along calibrated X-ray source-to-detector rays and sparse 2D CBCT projections y
output_desc: 连续 X-ray attenuation field mu(x) 与可查询 3D 重建
output_en: Continuous 3D X-ray attenuation coefficient field μ_θ(x) queried at arbitrary voxel grids

adapter.name: NAF
adapter.mechanism: A position-only hash-encoded attenuation field fits cone-ray line-integral measurements, with Beer-Lambert transmission exp(-integral).
limitations: Normalized synthetic attenuation values; no scanner calibration, CUDA marching or original CBCT architecture/configuration.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
